note: Monroe County PA publishes no queryable zoning district service. County GIS hub and assessment GIS page list no zoning layer; PASDA has only a Kittatinny Ridge boundary layer. Municipalities publish zoning only as static PDF maps (Stroud Twp, Tobyhanna) or in vendor viewers (Coolbaugh ZoningHub, no public REST endpoint found). Stroudsburg zoning is a PDF map.
